ai.q: What is an AI virtual placement cell?
ai.a: Shortlisted is India's first AI virtual placement cell - it uses intelligent job matching and real-time application tracking, combined with a dedicated human coordinator for every batch of 12. Think of it as your college placement cell, available 24/7, powered by AI.

course.a: No. Shortlisted is not a course or certificate program. It's an AI virtual placement cell focused on interviews, applications, and getting you hired.

batch.a: After you subscribe, you are automatically assigned to the current open batch (max 12 students). A dedicated coordinator is assigned to guide your batch while the AI engine keeps jobs and applications organised.

jobs.a: Jobs are posted on the DISHA platform by companies. Our AI placement engine and DISHA admins assign relevant openings to your Shortlisted batch based on your profile and readiness.

support.q: What kind of support can I expect?
support.a: You get AI-powered job matching and 24/7 dashboard tracking, plus a human batch coordinator for applications, interview prep, and live updates on shortlist and offer status.

refund.a: Subscription terms are shared at checkout. Contact support for exceptional cases - we are happy to clarify before you pay.
